field_sources.total_allocation_power: Base LeafVoter 0x382409fad8503FbCdbB27A4211551fa03e884078 gaugeStates(gauge).point (Aero official deployment); summed over every gauge in Base FactoryRegistry 0x7b2A2c12dC5Ea2a31455952a05031C3E4BB28F3E (Aero official deployment, https://github.com/Dromos-Labs/metadex-public/tree/main/deployment-addresses)
field_sources.pool_type: gauge factory (Aero gaugestack-base.json): volatile | stable | cl
field_sources.pair: Base pool contract token0()/token1()/tickSpacing() + ERC-20 symbol()
field_sources.fee_pct: CL: time-weighted mean of 24 pool.fee() reads (pips/1e4) at snapshot timestamp minus 0..23 hours, blocks resolved by timestamp (historical eth_call); volatile/stable: spot value
field_sources.fee_pct_spot: onchain at snapshot block: CL pool.fee() pips/1e4; volatile/stable PoolFactory.getFee() for a small probe swap, bps/100. Aero fees are dynamic (fee modules, MEV tax)
field_sources.gross_swap_fees_24h_usd_est: volume_24h_usd * fee_pct / 100. Gross swap fees, all LPs; estimate; not the amount paid to allocators
field_sources.emission_cap_aero_per_week: Base FactoryRegistry 0x7b2A2c12dC5Ea2a31455952a05031C3E4BB28F3E (Aero official deployment, https://github.com/Dromos-Labs/metadex-public/tree/main/deployment-addresses) emissionCap(gauge) * 604800 (a cap, not actual emissions)
field_sources.incentives_usd_per_week: not yet collected (null); planned: IncentiveStreaming programs per gauge

notes: incentives_usd_per_week is null for every pool: incentive programs are not read yet
gross_swap_fees_24h_usd_est = rolling 24h volume x time-weighted 24h mean fee (all LPs, not the amount paid to allocators)
emission_cap_aero_per_week is the FactoryRegistry cap (a ceiling), not realised emissions
Pools with fee_pct >= 1.0% or <$100k 24h volume on >=$500k TVL are flagged in pool.notes (e.g. AERO/USDC CL200 at 1.05% fee)
